sources.label: Custom Morphe patches by heval99
sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Turns off the inbox ads, banners, native ads and interstitials and stops the ad tracking pixels. The promotional cards the server places in the inbox (storage and eSIM hints, for example) go away with them.
Disables the app's usage tracking (Tracking2, Brain), INFOnline audience measurement, app monitoring and Sentry crash reporting. Push notifications keep working.
